defects.summary: Gear changes have no clutch interlock: request_gear(target, force) takes no clutch state and nothing in the call chain supplies it; measured shift accepted with the clutch fully open (pedal 0.00, engagement 0.00).
No road-speed guard on gear selection: reverse was engaged at 35 km/h by pressing gear_down four times (3->2->1->0->-1); one second later the drivetrain had dragged the car from 28.5 to 12.1 km/h.

HUD runs with PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS and TouchScreenButton input is not gated by pause, so a touch while paused still presses the action; measured throttle=true with tree.paused=true and no release on resume.

No release path on focus loss or OS interruption: no NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_OUT / NOTIFICATION_WM_WINDOW_FOCUS_OUT handler and no Input.action_release anywhere in scripts/ (only tools/capture.gd:71).
No drag/cancel semantics: passby_press=false and no SCREEN_DRAG handling, so a thumb that slides off the pedal keeps the action latched (measured: still pressed at 420,200) until it is lifted.

Fixed centres with scale-multiplied radii: at control_scale 1.35 the gear_down/throttle hit discs overlap by 43 px (175.5 vs 132.5 px) and brake/handbrake by 29.7 px, so the throttle steals part of the gear_down area.

Recover button centre is w-58 with r=36, so it overlaps the objective panel (w-316..w-24, y18..96) by 70x14 px and sits 22 px from the right screen edge; visible in 09_race_driving.png and the device capture.
control_opacity is exposed in settings and persisted but never read by the HUD (only control_scale is), so the opacity slider changes nothing.
All seven button faces are painted pixel by pixel in GDScript (nested loops, set_pixel per pixel); RaceHUD.setup() measured 111.0 ms on desktop for 7 buttons / 14 textures, before any mobile cost.
visibility_mode = VISIBILITY_ALWAYS draws the seven touch discs on desktop too; every race screenshot shows them over the world.

No safe-area handling: no DisplayServer.get_display_safe_area() anywhere in scripts/, while project.godot uses stretch aspect=expand and sensor-landscape, so pause/timer/recover sit in the cutout zone in one orientation.
Automatic gearbox schedules on engine rpm only (up_rpm/down_rpm plus a 0.45 s hold and a coarse speed gate); no load, gradient or slip input reaches auto_update().

control_scale upscales a raster texture generated at base radius instead of re-rendering it, so the button art is resampled (soft) above 1.0 even though the geometry stays centred and correctly sized.

A cold checkout cannot run the suite: with no .godot class cache the run exits 2 with 'Parse Error: Could not find type StageDef' until 'godot --headless --path . --import' is run manually; the script has no import step.
